findings.title: Security (surface 5): injection
findings.body:
Reachability: Feishu event field `event.message.content` enters at service/feishu_finance_agent.go:319-320 (`_ = common.UnmarshalJsonStr(msg.Content, &content)`; `text := strings.TrimSpace(feishuMentionPlaceholder.ReplaceAllString(content.Text, ""))`) and is persisted as `action.RawText` (feishu_finance_agent.go:334); service/feishu_finance_agent.go:350 `text := action.RawText` -> line 359 `cmd, err := parseFeishuFinanceAgentCommand(ctx, text)` -> service/feishu_finance_agent_client.go:286 `{'role': 'user', 'content': text}` -> chat/completions POST at client.go:349; the LLM's JSON reply is decoded into `feishuFinanceAgentCommand` (client.go:330-334), expanded into a plan by `buildFeishuFinanceAgentPlan` (feishu_finance_agent.go:177), and applied through the write path `executeFeishuFinanceAgentPlan` (`model.AddAffPromotionUsers`, `model.GrantAdminCredits`) once the confirm card is clicked.
Note: Prompt injection: attacker-influenced text (the operator may paste third-party content, or injected text rides along in an @-mention group message) is concatenated verbatim as the user turn of the LLM prompt, and the model's structured output selects the target account, commission rate (up to 50%), withdrawal toggle and up to 1,000,000 gift credits that the single write path applies. Mitigations exist but do not remove the path: sender whitelist plus live Root re-check (`authorizeFeishuFinanceAgentOperator`), the requirement that the target account literally appear in the raw text (`feishuFinanceAgentTargetMentioned`), deterministic server-side numeric bounds, a 30-minute TTL, and a human confirm card that echoes the raw text with regex-based injection hints — a successful injection only has to survive the operator's glance at the card.
findings.recommendation: Fix the issue, or provide evidence that the path is not reachable.

findings.title: Security (surface 7): SSRF
findings.body:
Reachability: env var FEISHU_FINANCE_AGENT_OPENAPI_BASE read at setting/feishu_finance_agent_setting.go:32 -> setting.GetFeishuFinanceAgentSetting() -> cfg.OpenAPIBase -> StartFeishuFinanceAgentWS -> runFeishuFinanceAgentWSSession -> feishuFinanceAgentWSDomain(cfg.OpenAPIBase) -> larkws.WithDomain(domain) at line 102 -> larkws.NewClient(cfg.AppID, cfg.AppSecret, opts...) at line 105 -> client.Start dials the configured host
Note: The outbound websocket host is taken verbatim from a deployment env var with no allowlist or scheme/host validation. AppID/AppSecret are presented to whatever host is configured, so a malicious or misconfigured FEISHU_FINANCE_AGENT_OPENAPI_BASE exfiltrates the app secret and lets an impostor endpoint feed forged message/card-callback events into a flow that grants credits and changes commission settings. The same env-controlled-base pattern exists for FEISHU_FINANCE_AGENT_LLM_BASE_URL (LLMAPIKey would be sent to that base), but its sink in service/feishu_finance_agent_client.go is not part of the supplied diff. Source is deploy-time env, not remote input, which bounds practical exploitability.
findings.recommendation: Fix the issue, or provide evidence that the path is not reachable.
